grammar.pattern: 光 / 仅 / 仅仅 / 就 / 至少
grammar.purpose: Read scope and minimum quantities accurately
grammar.explanation: 光带笔就行 means a pen alone suffices in this context; it does not claim pens are the only permitted object. 仅/仅仅 restrict scope. 就两个人 emphasizes a small exact count. 至少两个人 sets a minimum of two, allowing more. 至少提前一天 sets a minimum lead time, not exactly one day. Keep only, sufficiency and minimum distinct.

examples.zh: 就两个人，不是至少两个人。

examples.en: Exactly two people, not at least two.

examples.en: Sign up at least one day ahead.

commonMistakes.wrong: 至少两个就是只能两个。
commonMistakes.why: A minimum does not impose a maximum.

grammar.purpose: Describe plentiful supplies without claiming unlimited capacity
grammar.explanation: 材料有的是 / 有的是材料 says materials are plentiful. It does not give an exact number and does not transfer that abundance to seats, time or places. Distinguish the idiomatic plentiful construction from 有的材料…: some of the materials. In a practical notice, verify each resource separately.
